summary: Verified anti-hang canvas frame-poll rewrite + digital/optical zoom + backend watchdog. Created /app/9x_security/tests/test_frame_ptz_watchdog.py — 11/11 pytest pass covering: /api/frame 401 without token, 404 when disconnected with token, 200 image/jpeg + Cache-Control: no-store when connected, JPEG magic bytes; /api/state frame_age null when disconnected and 0.0–3.0 while streaming; two consecutive /api/frame bodies differ (live, not frozen); watchdog reconnect logs 'stream lost, reconnecting (watchdog)' after a 2s EOF clip; /api/ptz/zoom returns supported:false quickly for unreachable/file rtsp_url; service.py invokes ptz.reset_cache() from /api/camera/connect (verified via source and endpoint success); and re-ran /app/9x_security/test_ptz.py 6/6 direct PTZ tests as a subprocess (ALL PTZ TESTS PASSED). Playwright UI test against http://127.0.0.1:8971/ (with a cv2-generated 90s AVI as the camera source) confirmed: login+force-change (admin/9xsecurity->NxTest@2026); camera reaches 'Connected — live monitoring chalu hai'; [data-testid=video-canvas] pixel sum at center changes across a 1.2s gap (255011 -> 137643); [data-testid=zoom-level] 1.0x with [data-testid=digital-zoom-out-btn] disabled at 1x, digital-zoom-in-btn steps to 1.2x -> 1.4x, [data-testid=zoom-reset-btn] returns to 1.0x; PTZ [data-testid=ptz-zoom-in-btn] mouse-hold triggers POST /api/ptz/zoom once and (supported:false) hides both PTZ buttons; Draw Detection Line resets zoom from 1.4x -> 1.0x and 2 clicks on canvas POST /api/line; 30s soak while connected shows 150 /api/frame polls and ZERO /api/stream calls (regression confirmed — UI no longer creates long-lived MJPEG connections); page remains responsive (nav-settings/nav-dashboard clickable, Settings page renders); sidebar [data-testid=outbox-pending-count] still shows 'WA Pending: 0'. Cleanup: camera disconnected, config.json rtsp_url restored from /tmp/config.json.bak (back to /app/9x_security/test_clip.avi), admin password reset to '9xsecurity' via POST /api/settings, both test_clip_*.avi removed, events/outbox both 0.
critical_code_review_comments: CameraPanel: ptzSupported is initialised to true and only flipped to false after a failed press; it never re-enables when the user connects a different (ONVIF-capable) camera. Consider setPtzSupported(true) in the state.connected effect / on rtsp_url change so PTZ buttons re-appear after reconnect to a supported cam.

service.py /api/stream still exists (line 306) and is unauth-protected via _check but no longer used by UI. Since the hang RCA was MJPEG, consider removing or gating it behind a debug flag to prevent accidental re-introduction of the leak.

service.py worker.latest() is not shown but /api/frame returns None -> 404 tightly; add a small in-memory rate/lru so bursts of /api/frame from multiple clients don't repeatedly re-encode. Low-priority.

CameraPanel frame poll fetch does not send `credentials:'omit'` and appends r=Date.now() cachebuster — fine, but consider AbortController on unmount to cancel in-flight fetch (currently relies on `live` flag after resolve).
The 4 console 404s during login are for missing favicon/manifest/apple-touch-icon assets in electron/dist/ — harmless in Electron shell but shows in browser.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all target flows (canvas live, zoom, PTZ hide, draw-line, 30s soak no /api/stream, badge, settings)

test_credentials: admin / 9xsecurity (restored at end; first login still triggers force-change screen by design)
seed_data_creation: Test AVIs test_clip_short.avi (2s) and test_clip_long.avi (30s and 90s variants) generated with cv2.VideoWriter (MJPG, 320x240, 15fps, moving colored square). All removed at teardown; snapshots/ and events.db verified empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Service at http://127.0.0.1:8971 (not the platform preview URL). Container has no camera/ONVIF — use cv2-generated .avi as source (POST /api/camera/connect with file path). First connect after service restart takes ~30-60s for YOLO model load. Pytest test_watchdog_reconnects_on_short_clip needs a >20s wait (watchdog trips after 15s of no good frame). PTZ test against real ONVIF cannot be done here; test_ptz.py mock is the source of truth. Config.json/pw are restored — if you re-run pytest, note that it mutates rtsp_url via /api/camera/connect; restore from /tmp/config.json.bak if needed.
rca of the issue: No new bugs. All items in the review request verified working: /api/frame auth+404+200 matrix, frame_age in /api/state, watchdog reconnect log, PTZ supported:false path via file-path rtsp_url, ptz.reset_cache() on connect, canvas draws changing pixels (proves anti-hang MJPEG->JPEG-poll rewrite works), digital zoom 1x/1.2x/1.4x + reset + zoom-out disabled at 1x, PTZ button hides + toast on supported:false, Draw Detection Line resets zoom + POST /api/line, 30s soak zero /api/stream calls with page responsive, outbox badge regression green, settings page loads.
